name: lasso_sparse_factor_core
hypothesis: Double-selection LASSO (Feng-Giglio-Xiu 2020) applied to 268 Factor DB factors identifies 10-20 genuinely priced factors in the Korean cross-section, reducing redundancy (e.g., 13 defense vol variants → 2-3 core) and enabling a sparse multi-factor portfolio that outperforms the 4-family heuristic allocation.

background.redundancy_problem: Top 20 ICIR: 13 defense vol variants (D01~D58), many correlated >0.9. Current heuristic uses 4 families (Defense/IndMom/Consensus/QualRev) — suboptimal if cross-family interactions exist.
background.prior_failure_L531: Composite z-score of all 268 factors = signal dilution. Stock-level composite structural limit.
background.prior_failure_L532: ICIR ranking != portfolio alpha. High IC factors may not contribute in portfolio context.
background.key_insight: LASSO does NOT select by IC magnitude alone — it selects by INCREMENTAL contribution controlling for other factors. This directly solves the L-531/L-532 failures by identifying factors with genuinely independent information.
method_papers: Feng, Giglio, Xiu (2020) 'Taming the Factor Zoo' JF 75(3) — Double-selection LASSO with valid post-selection t-stats
Bryzgalova, Pelger, Zhu (2025) 'Forest Through the Trees' JF 80(5) — AP-trees for conditional sort hierarchy
Gu, Kelly, Xiu (2020) 'Empirical Asset Pricing via ML' RFS 33(5) — LASSO/Ridge/ElasticNet comparison on 94 characteristics

step1_data_prep.description: Load factor cross-section monthly via load_month_factors(). Pivot to wide: Ticker x Factor_Name. Use Z_Score_Aligned only (C13).
step1_data_prep.pit_rule: Only months where Usable_Date <= sig_date (C14). Expanding window training set.
step1_data_prep.target: Forward 1-month excess return (Ret - BM_Ret) from RAWDATA. Computed at t, return realized at t+1.
step1_data_prep.universe_filter: Liq filter: 20d avg Vol >= 2e8. Coverage >= 50% of factors.

step2_double_selection_lasso.description: Fama-MacBeth regression with LASSO selection. Each month t: (1) LASSO on cross-section Y[t+1] ~ X[t], (2) Record selected factors. Across all months: keep factors selected in >50% of months.
step2_double_selection_lasso.implementation: R package: glmnet. alpha=1 (pure LASSO). lambda chosen by expanding-window CV (5-fold within training set). NOT full-sample CV (C1 violation).
step2_double_selection_lasso.output: Sparse factor set S = {f1, ..., fK} where K ~ 10-20
step2_double_selection_lasso.validation: For each factor in S, compute OLS t-stat in Fama-MacBeth controlling for all other S factors. Keep only |t| > 2.0 (conservative). Harvey et al. (2016) suggests t>3.0 for new factors, but within-model selection already controls multiplicity.

step3_sparse_portfolio.description: Build multi-factor score from sparse set S. Score = equal-weighted sum of Z_Score_Aligned for selected factors. Top 30 stocks by score.
step3_sparse_portfolio.construction: EW within top 30. Monthly rebalancing + BZ 50/25.
step3_sparse_portfolio.overlays: VT + DD from STR_1071 architecture (v7.1 regime engine). No new overlay parameters.
step3_sparse_portfolio.benchmark: Compare vs STR_1071 (4-family heuristic) and STR_1036 (5-sleeve Gerber HRP).

step4_robustness.elastic_net: Repeat with alpha=0.5 (elastic net) to check sensitivity to collinearity handling.
step4_robustness.stability_selection: Meinshausen & Buhlmann (2010): subsample LASSO 100x, keep factors selected in >60% of subsamples. More stable than single LASSO.
step4_robustness.rolling_vs_expanding: Compare expanding-window selection vs 120-month rolling. Expanding preferred (more data), rolling checks regime-dependence.

data_source: Factor DB via load_month_factors() — 268 factors x Z_Score_Aligned (C13/C15)
RAWDATA.parquet — returns, market cap, volume for universe/target

pit_compliance.C1: Expanding-window LASSO training. No full-sample lambda or factor selection.
pit_compliance.C2: Factor scores at t, returns at t+1. No same-day circular.
pit_compliance.C3: Selection set determined by months [1..t-1], applied at t.
pit_compliance.C4: Fundamental factors in DB already have C4 lag built in.
pit_compliance.C5: VT/DD overlays use t-1 (from STR_1071 architecture).
pit_compliance.C11: FRED-based factors in DB already have expanding percentile (v7.1).
pit_compliance.C12: Lambda chosen by expanding-window CV, NOT full-sample. Factor set updated monthly.
pit_compliance.C13: Z_Score_Aligned only. No manual direction flipping.
pit_compliance.C14: IC used for align_factor_direction() uses Usable_Date. LASSO training uses Usable_Date <= sig_date.
pit_compliance.C15: All factor access via load_month_factors(). No direct parquet reads.

expected_outcomes.expected_composition: 2-3 defense (from 56), 1-2 consensus, 1-2 value, 1 momentum, 1-2 quality, 1-2 accrual, possibly 1-2 cross-family interaction
expected_outcomes.key_value: Interpretable sparse model. Eliminates redundant factors. Discovers cross-family synergies missed by heuristic allocation.
expected_outcomes.alpha_lab_gate: |ICIR| >= 0.15 AND |t-stat| >= 1.5 on Fama-MacBeth lambda for surviving factors

implementation_notes: PHASE 1: Data matrix construction (1-2 hours)
- For each month m in [2010-01 .. 2026-02]: load_month_factors(m)
- Pivot wide: Ticker x Factor (Z_Score_Aligned). Join with Ret[m+1] from RAWDATA
- Handle missing: drop stocks with <50% factor coverage per month
- Result: panel ~200 months x ~800 stocks x 268 factors
PHASE 2: Expanding-window LASSO selection (2-3 hours)
- For each signal month t (t >= 2015-01, min 60 months training):
a. Training set: months [2010-01 .. t-1]
b. Pool cross-sections (Fama-MacBeth style): stack all training months
c. glmnet(y = excess_ret, x = factor_matrix, alpha = 1)
d. lambda = cv.glmnet expanding-window (5-fold within training)
e. Record selected factors (nonzero coefficients)
- Aggregate: factor frequency across all t. Keep >50% frequency factors.
PHASE 3: Sparse portfolio backtest (1 hour)
- Score = sum(Z_Score_Aligned[selected factors]) per stock per month
- Top 30 stocks, EW, BZ 50/25, monthly rebal
- Apply VT + DD overlays (v7.1 regime engine)
- Compute: CAGR, SR, MDD, TO, FF5 alpha, Fama-MacBeth lambda
PHASE 4: Robustness + comparison (1 hour)
- Elastic net (alpha=0.5) variant
- Stability selection (100 subsamples)
- Compare vs STR_1071/1036 baselines
- Factor importance ranking → methodology_memory.md update
TOTAL ESTIMATED: 5-6 hours execution
risk_factors: LASSO may select different factors each expanding window → unstable TO. Stability selection mitigates this.
268 factors with ~800 stocks = p > n/3 per month. Regularization essential but may over-shrink weak signals.
Korean market structural breaks (2008 GFC, 2020 COVID) may cause regime-dependent factor selection.
glmnet requires complete cases — missing factor coverage could bias toward large-cap (more coverage).
L-531 warning: even LASSO-selected composite may dilute if selected set is too large (>25 factors).
references: Feng, Giglio & Xiu (2020) 'Taming the Factor Zoo: A Test of New Factors' JF 75(3), 1327-1370 — Double-selection LASSO methodology
Gu, Kelly & Xiu (2020) 'Empirical Asset Pricing via Machine Learning' RFS 33(5), 2223-2273 — ML comparison benchmark
Meinshausen & Buhlmann (2010) 'Stability Selection' JRSS-B 72(4), 417-473 — Stability selection for robust LASSO
Harvey, Liu & Zhu (2016) '...and the Cross-Section of Expected Returns' RFS 29(1), 5-68 — Multiple testing threshold t>3.0
Bryzgalova, Pelger & Zhu (2025) 'Forest Through the Trees' JF 80(5) — AP-trees conditional hierarchy
L-531: Composite z-score 268 factors = signal dilution. LASSO solves by selecting sparse set.
L-532: ICIR ranking != portfolio alpha. LASSO selects by incremental contribution.
L-533: Factor DB correct usage = sleeve weighting optimization + new alpha search.
